description: This file defines the interface for the Cobalt extension graphics API, including structures and function pointers for managing graphics rendering, color adjustments, frame timing, and support for 360 videos.

methods.name: GetMaximumFrameIntervalInMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns the maximum time between rendered frames, used for frame rate control.

methods.name: GetMinimumFrameIntervalInMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns the minimum time between frames, used for throttling frame rate.

methods.name: IsMapToMeshEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if 360-degree video support via map-to-mesh is enabled.

methods.name: ShouldClearFrameOnShutdown
methods.description: Determines if the framebuffer should be cleared on shutdown and provides the clear color.

methods.name: GetMapToMeshColorAdjustments
methods.description: Provides color adjustment parameters for 360 videos.

methods.name: GetRenderRootTransform
methods.description: Provides a custom transform matrix for rendering.

methods.name: ReportFullyDrawn
methods.description: Signals that the web app has completed drawing.
